tailoring.headline: SAP Hybris (SAP Commerce Cloud) Technical Lead | Senior Java & Spring Developer with 5+ years enterprise e-commerce delivery
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and microservices, with proven design of data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, global production support and stakeholder-focused techno-functional analysis. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer leveraging AI-assisted development for rapid, high-quality delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris (SAP Commerce Cloud) Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am drawn to Priyanka Jain’s focus on innovative SAP Commerce Cloud projects, and the Technical Lead role perfectly matches my 5+ years of hands-on Hybris experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My background in driving complex e-commerce solutions positions me to contribute immediately.

bullets.label: Technical Design
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, delivering robust product, catalog and pricing models aligned with architectural standards.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM-ERP-MDM data pipelines via Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless synchronization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Team Guidance
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance and performed code reviews for junior developers, translating business requirements into functional specifications and user stories in a techno-functional role.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Led production troubleshooting, CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 and optimized database queries, reducing latency and maintaining high availability for mission-critical commerce sites.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Priyanka Jain’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce Cloud solutions aligns perfectly with my passion for building scalable, AI-enhanced e-commerce platforms. I am impressed by your recent multi-regional rollout that leverages headless commerce and advanced data integration – a challenge where my five years of hands-on Hybris experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell can add immediate value and drive further innovation.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to lead SAP Commerce Cloud initiatives that push technical boundaries and deliver measurable business impact.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Technical Lead role at Priyanka Jain and would love to discuss how I can contribute. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Hybris (SAP Commerce Cloud) Technical Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Hybris (SAP Commerce Cloud) Technical Lead position. With over five years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my technical design, integration and leadership skills to your team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.
